definitions.explanation: A bathroom fixture with a basin for washing the face and hands, often with storage and a mirror.

examples.japanese: {洗面台|せんめんだい}で{顔|かお}を{洗|あら}う。
examples.english: Wash your face at the washstand.

examples.japanese: {洗面台|せんめんだい}の{鏡|かがみ}が{曇|くも}っている。
examples.english: The mirror on the washstand is fogged up.

examples.japanese: {洗面台|せんめんだい}の{下|した}に{収納|しゅうのう}スペースがある。
examples.english: There's storage space under the washstand.

notes:
A standard fixture in Japanese bathrooms, located in the {脱衣所|だついじょ} (changing room) separate from the bathing area.

Components:
- {洗面|せんめん}ボウル (basin/bowl)
- {蛇口|じゃぐち}/水栓 (faucet)
- {鏡|かがみ} (mirror)
- {収納|しゅうのう}{棚|だな} (storage shelf)
- {照明|しょうめい} (lighting)

Also called:
- {洗面化粧台|せんめんけしょうだい} (vanity with makeup function)
- {洗面器|せんめんき} (washbasin only)

Common items kept at the 洗面台:
- {歯|は}ブラシ、{歯磨|はみが}き{粉|こ} (toothbrush, toothpaste)
- {洗顔料|せんがんりょう} (face wash)
- {化粧品|けしょうひん} (cosmetics)
- ドライヤー (hair dryer)
